title: `guides/page-builder.md` says "five registered types do all the structural work" and omits `section`, which is registered and authored in the catalogue
body:
Found while implementing #7360, measured at `origin/main@0614b6d`. Unassigned.

## The claim and the measurement

`skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`, section "3b. Pick the right layout primitive":

> Five registered types do all the structural work.

The table then names `flex`, `stack`, `grid`, `container` and `box`. `section` is not among them, and the token occurs **0 times in the whole guide**.

It is nonetheless a real registered structural type:

- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:988` — `ComponentRegistry.register('section', PageSectionRenderer, { ... })`
- authored in the schema catalogue: `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-layout-semantic/section.json`, and used inside `blog-article.json` and `complete-layout.json` in the same directory

So the sentence is a closed-set claim ("five ... do all the structural work") that is measurably not closed. That is the shape this repo's own doc gates exist to stop — an agent reading the guide has no way to reach `section`, and the guide actively tells it the set is complete.

## Why it is filed rather than fixed

#7360 funds exactly one addition to the published skill (a `PluginScope.registerComponent` row in `guides/plugin-development.md`) and, for every other row, only re-pointing or dropping an eval token — never adding a token the guide does not contain. Teaching `section` is an addition to a second guide, outside that card.

It surfaced there because `evals/page-builder.json` eval 2 required the literal `section` while scoring this guide. That eval row was re-pointed at `card`, the composition the guide does teach; the type itself was left untouched and is recorded here.

## Two dispositions, both defensible

1. **Teach it** — one row in the layout-primitive table and a corrected count, if `section` is a type authors should reach for. Its renderer name (`PageSectionRenderer`) and its catalogue usage suggest a real semantic-landmark role that `box` does not fill.
2. **Say the set is not closed** — if `section` is deliberately not part of the recommended vocabulary, the sentence should stop claiming it is, so the next reader does not have to re-derive this.

Either way the fix is paid for in the same file per the skills programme's shrink-or-neutral rule (#7251 measured that this repo has no skills token ratchet).
